lastCompletedStory.title: End the implementer and reviewer waits at the floor with a cause-bearing terminal

nextStoryContext: US-003 (CAM-479) wired US-002's pure early-death detector (src/supervisor/early-death.ts) into both poll loops. loop.ts: `earlyDeathProbeFn` (RunSupervisorOptions, optional) is consulted once per implementer poll tick, right after the isPaneAlive check and before the report/sentinel checks; a 'dead-on-first-turn' verdict sets pollOutcome='session-died-early' and breaks immediately (proven <10% of both the 30-min host cap and the 60-min container cap in-test). review.ts: `earlyDeathProbeFn` (MakeReviewDispatchOptions, optional) is consulted symmetrically in the reviewer poll loop. Both phases route the early-death outcome through the EXISTING dead-worker-streak/backoff/MAX_DEAD_WORKER_RETRIES machinery (loop.ts) or the EXISTING MAX_REVIEW_DISPATCH_ATTEMPTS retry path (review.ts) -- no second retry mechanism. Terminal emission is split into two independent calls: `runCheckedWorkerSentinel` (unchanged, kills/respawns the stuck pane, same as the pre-existing timeout branch) followed by a NEW `emitEarlyDeathTerminal` (verified-dispatch.ts) that emits reason='session-died-early' plus the verbatim transcript cause on all three observable channels (dispatch-failed event, durable DispatchFailedMarker, orchestrator notification). `emitEarlyDeathTerminal` takes a new narrower `DispatchFailureEmitOptions` interface (no tmux dispatch fields) since it has nothing to report from a real command result; `VerifiedDispatchOptions` is a structural supertype so `emitDispatchFailure`'s existing implementation serves both without duplication. `DispatchFailureReason` (verified-dispatch.ts) gained the 'session-died-early' member. Production wiring: host.ts declares a single `earlyDeathProbeFn = makeEarlyDeathProbe({cwd, claudeDir: transcriptClaudeDir})` shared between the implementer opts bag and the reviewer dispatch, reusing the SAME transcriptClaudeDir variable the pre-existing US-013 token reader already resolves (they can never diverge). All 10 acceptance-criteria oracles pass individually (18/18 tests in dispatch-early-death.test.ts, loop.test.ts + review.test.ts stay green at 254/254, full suite 5901/5901, typecheck clean, full `bun run check:all` spine green including coverage/dead-code/dup/file-size). No open questions or follow-ups identified for this story; CAM-479's epic scope (US-001 cause field, US-002 detector, US-003 wiring) is now complete per the PRD notes trail.
